title: D2P Feature Graph
description: Feature graph of a pattern (design decisions ADR-006, ADR-006.1, ADR-006.2): the parametric points, curves and constraints from which geometry is derived. Parametrics are the source of truth; geometry is derived by an evaluator. Dependency edges run from a feature to every feature named in a …FeatureId member of its params, every featureOutput.featureId and param.parameterId inside its expressions, and every dependsOn entry of an extension type. Measurement inputs are leaves.

featureList.title: Feature list
featureList.description: The features of a pattern, in authoring order. Feature IDs share the document-wide element ID namespace (uniqueness is D2P-REF-005). Evaluation order is the topological order of the dependency graph with ties broken by 'id'; the graph MUST be acyclic (D2P-SEM-001).

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: One node of the feature graph: a point, curve or constraint of feature set 1.0.0, or an extension feature type. For a d2p: type, 'params' is validated by the closed params object of that type. Extension types (any extension name) have open 'params' and MUST declare 'dependsOn'; d2p: types MUST NOT declare 'dependsOn' (their dependencies are derived from …FeatureId members and expressions).

id.description: Stable element ID of the feature.

type.description: Feature type: a d2p: type of feature set 1.0.0 or an extension feature type.

params.description: Type-specific parameters. Closed for d2p: types (see the *Params definitions); open for extension types, where a matching feature capability MAY describe them.

dependsOn.description: Explicit dependencies (features or parameters) of an extension feature type. Required for extension types, not used by d2p: types.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

featureType.title: Feature type
featureType.description: Feature type. The d2p: values are the closed feature set 1.0.0; any other d2p: name is a structural error. Extension feature types are extension names and need exactly one matching feature capability in the pattern (D2P-SEM-005).

pointAbsoluteParams.title: Absolute point parameters
pointAbsoluteParams.description: Params of d2p:point.absolute. Point at absolute coordinates. Outputs: x, y (length).

x.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

y.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

pointOffsetParams.title: Offset point parameters
pointOffsetParams.description: Params of d2p:point.offset. Point offset from a base point by (dx, dy). Outputs: x, y (length).

baseFeatureId.description: Element ID of the base point feature in the same pattern.

dx.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

dy.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

pointPolarParams.title: Polar point parameters
pointPolarParams.description: Params of d2p:point.polar. Point at a distance and angle from a base point; the angle is counter-clockwise from +X. Outputs: x, y (length).

baseFeatureId.description: Element ID of the base point feature in the same pattern.

distance.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

angle.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension angle (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

pointAlongCurveParams.title: Along-curve point parameters
pointAlongCurveParams.description: Params of d2p:point.along-curve. Point at an arc-length distance from the start of a curve. A distance outside [0, curve length] is D2P-EVL-008. Outputs: x, y (length).

curveFeatureId.description: Element ID of the curve feature in the same pattern.

distance.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

pointIntersectionParams.title: Intersection point parameters
pointIntersectionParams.description: Params of d2p:point.intersection. The index-th intersection of two curves, ordered by parameter on curve A. A missing intersection is D2P-EVL-004. Outputs: x, y (length).

curveAFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first curve (curve A) feature in the same pattern.

curveBFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second curve (curve B) feature in the same pattern.

index.description: Zero-based index of the intersection, ordered by parameter on curve A.

pointMirrorParams.title: Mirror point parameters
pointMirrorParams.description: Params of d2p:point.mirror. A point mirrored across a line. Outputs: x, y (length).

pointFeatureId.description: Element ID of the point to mirror feature in the same pattern.

axisFeatureId.description: Element ID of the line used as mirror axis feature in the same pattern.

pointFreeParams.title: Free point parameters
pointFreeParams.description: Params of d2p:point.free. A solver-controlled point; x and y are initial values only. Constraints act on free points and their dependents. Outputs: x, y (length).

x.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

y.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

lineParams.title: Line parameters
lineParams.description: Params of d2p:line. Straight segment from start to end point. Outputs: length (length), angle (angle).

startFeatureId.description: Element ID of the start point feature in the same pattern.

endFeatureId.description: Element ID of the end point feature in the same pattern.

arcParams.title: Arc parameters
arcParams.description: Params of d2p:arc. Circular arc from start to end around a center. Start and end not equidistant from the center is D2P-EVL-009. Outputs: length, radius (length), sweep (angle).

startFeatureId.description: Element ID of the start point feature in the same pattern.

endFeatureId.description: Element ID of the end point feature in the same pattern.

centerFeatureId.description: Element ID of the center point feature in the same pattern.

direction.description: Sweep direction from start to end: counter-clockwise or clockwise.

bezierCubicParams.title: Cubic Bezier parameters
bezierCubicParams.description: Params of d2p:bezier.cubic. Cubic Bezier curve defined by four points. Output: length (length).

startFeatureId.description: Element ID of the start point feature in the same pattern.

control1FeatureId.description: Element ID of the first control point feature in the same pattern.

control2FeatureId.description: Element ID of the second control point feature in the same pattern.

endFeatureId.description: Element ID of the end point feature in the same pattern.

constraintCoincidentParams.title: Coincident constraint parameters
constraintCoincidentParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.coincident. Two points coincide. A coincident constraint does not make point features identical for contour closure.

aFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first point feature in the same pattern.

bFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second point feature in the same pattern.

constraintDistanceParams.title: Distance constraint parameters
constraintDistanceParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.distance. Distance between two points equals 'value'. A constant negative value or two conflicting constant values on the same unordered point pair is D2P-SEM-040.

aFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first point feature in the same pattern.

bFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second point feature in the same pattern.

value.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

constraintLengthParams.title: Length constraint parameters
constraintLengthParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.length. Length of a curve equals 'value'. A constant negative value or two conflicting constant values on the same curve is D2P-SEM-040.

curveFeatureId.description: Element ID of the curve feature in the same pattern.

value.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

constraintAngleParams.title: Angle constraint parameters
constraintAngleParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.angle. Angle between two lines (ordered pair) equals 'value'. Two conflicting constant values on the same ordered line pair is D2P-SEM-040.

aFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first line feature in the same pattern.

bFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second line feature in the same pattern.

value.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension angle (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

constraintLineParams.title: Line orientation constraint parameters
constraintLineParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.horizontal / d2p:constraint.vertical. Shared parameters of d2p:constraint.horizontal and d2p:constraint.vertical. Both on the same line is D2P-SEM-040.

lineFeatureId.description: Element ID of the constrained line feature in the same pattern.

constraintLinePairParams.title: Line pair constraint parameters
constraintLinePairParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.parallel / d2p:constraint.perpendicular. Shared parameters of d2p:constraint.parallel and d2p:constraint.perpendicular. Both on the same unordered line pair is D2P-SEM-040.

aFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first line feature in the same pattern.

bFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second line feature in the same pattern.

constraintTangentParams.title: Tangent constraint parameters
constraintTangentParams.description: Params of d2p:constraint.tangent. Two curves sharing an endpoint feature are tangent at that endpoint.

aFeatureId.description: Element ID of the first curve feature in the same pattern.

bFeatureId.description: Element ID of the second curve feature in the same pattern.
